from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first file in names readable inside NOTES_DIR.

    Names are relative to NOTES_DIR and come from untrusted input. Only
    regular files that resolve to a location inside NOTES_DIR are read.
    Missing, unreadable, or out-of-bounds names are skipped. Returns an
    empty string when no name yields a readable file.
    """
    base = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    for name in names:
        if "\x00" in name:
            continue
        try:
            candidate = (base / name).resolve()
            if not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
    return ""


def _make_notes(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    return notes


def test_returns_first_readable_in_order(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("B", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "B"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "y.txt"]) == ""


def test_reads_file_in_subdirectory_of_notes(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "sub" / "c.txt").write_text("C", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["sub/c.txt"]) == "C"


def test_parent_traversal_is_blocked(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nested_traversal_is_blocked(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_is_blocked(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable([str(secret.resolve())]) == ""


def test_symlink_escaping_notes_is_blocked(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        (notes / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
    except OSError:
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported on this platform")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path)
    (notes / "dir").mkdir()
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("OK", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["dir", "ok.txt"]) == "OK"


def test_nul_byte_name_does_not_raise(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["a\x00b.txt"]) == ""
